content: Muxatsi wakuraru hepaɨtsita
»Yurikɨ mɨpaɨ nekanaineni, kemɨ'ane kitenie mɨkaheutahani muxatsi wakuraruta, huteikɨ pɨta meutimake, mɨkɨ tinawayame kanihɨkɨtɨni katininawamɨkɨ.
Kemɨ'ane kitenie meutahani, muxatsi kaniwahɨwemetɨni.
Kitenie tihɨweme katineiyepiriwani. Muxatsi niukieya mekani'enieka, yuxexuime pɨwarahɨawe yumuxatsi kememɨtetetewa, kaniwaranuyewitɨni wakuraruta.
Kepauka yumuxatsima yunaime mɨwaranuyewitɨni, mɨkɨ 'anuyekaitɨ kaniumieni. Muxatsi 'utɨmana mekaniweiyani niukieyatsie memimatekɨ.
Peru kuyeikame mepɨka'anukuweiya, mekaniyuta'unakuni pɨta ku'uwamete waniukitsie memɨkawamatekɨ».
Ketsutsi 'ikɨ 'ɨkitsika xatatɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwakuxaxatɨwakaitɨni, mɨkɨ 'atsimepɨkatehetima tita mɨtihɨkɨtɨkai mɨtiwakuxaxatɨwakai.
'Ayumieme tawarita mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni Ketsutsi: «Yurikɨ mɨpaɨ nekanaineni, ne muxatsi nekaniwakitenietɨni.
Yunaitɨ memu'axɨa nekanuawekaku 'akuxi ne, tenawayamete mekanihɨkɨtɨni, mekaniwanawatɨweni. Peru muxatsi mepɨkawaru'eni.
Ne nekanikitenietɨni, nekɨmana xɨka tewi heutahani, kanitawikweitsitɨariemɨkɨ. Kaneutahamɨkɨ kaniwayeyeikamɨkɨ, makutsiɨraɨye kanetamariekaxɨamɨkɨ.
Tinawayame wanawamɨtɨ wakwimɨtɨ wata'unamɨtɨ xeikɨa kani'axeni. Ne pɨta nekaninuani tukari memexeiyanikɨ, 'anayuhayewame memexeiyanikɨ.
»Ne muxatsi wahɨweme 'aixɨa nemɨtiuka'iyari nekanihɨkɨtɨni. Muxatsi wahɨweme 'aixɨa mɨtiuka'iyari yutukari kaniyetuani muxatsi wahetsiemieme.

Ti'iwame, kemɨ'ane muxatsi mɨkawahɨweme, muxatsi mɨkawakutsiyari, mɨkɨ kepauka 'ɨrawe mɨxeiya 'a'amiekame, mɨkɨ muxatsi kaniwaruku'e'eiriwani kaniyuta'unani. 'Ɨrawe kaniwatiwiyamɨkɨ kaniwataxɨriexɨamɨkɨ.
Mɨkɨ mɨti'iwamekɨ xeikɨa muxatsi wahekɨ pɨkayu'iyaritɨa, puyuta'una.
»Ne muxatsi wahɨweme 'aixɨa nemɨtiuka'iyari nekanihɨkɨtɨni, nemuxatsima nepɨwamate, mɨkɨta menetemate,
yaxeikɨa ne'ukiyari mɨnetimate hepaɨ, neta ne'ukiyari kenemɨtimate hepaɨ. Netukari nekaniyetuani muxatsi wahetsiemieme.

Hipameta muxatsi nepɨwarexeiya 'ikɨ xeikuraruyarita memɨkamiemete. Kaneuyeweka mɨkɨta nemɨwa'atɨanikɨ. Neniuki mekani'eniekuni, xeikuraruyari mehexeiyatɨ mekanakɨnikuni meta muxatsi wahɨweme xeime xeikɨa mehexeiyatɨ.
'Ayumieme ne'ukiyari kaneninaki'erieka netukari nemɨyetuakɨ tawari nemitanaki'erienikɨ.
Xewitɨ pɨkanetsinawairieni, nekɨmana pɨta nekaniyetuamɨkɨ. Heitserie nekanexeiyani nemiyetuanikɨ, heitserie nerexeiyata tawari nemitanaki'erienikɨ. 'Ipaɨ ne'ukiyari kanetiniu'aitɨani».
Merikɨtsɨ tawari hixɨata mekaniyutsana huriyutsixi 'ikɨ niukieyakɨ.
Yumɨiretɨ mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuanekaitɨni: «Kari kakaɨyari 'axamɨ'ane kaninɨka, pɨkayumate. ¿Titayari xete'i'enie?»
Hipatɨta mete'utiyuanekai: «'Ikɨ niukieya, kakaɨyari 'axamɨ'ane minɨ'ɨ kapɨniukieya. ¿Kakaɨyari 'axamɨ'ane ketiyɨwe mɨwaranutanieritɨani memɨkaheuneniere?»
Huriyutsixi kememɨte'ixani'eri Ketsutsi
Merikɨtsɨ 'ana 'ixɨarari kanaye'ani kepauka tuki mu'itiyatsie Kerutsareme. 'Ana kaniuhaɨtɨkaitɨni,
Ketsutsi tuki kuraruyarita kaniyeyeikakaitɨni Tsarumuni kiiya hetsie meukuwewiyakai hetɨa.
Hikɨ huriyutsixi 'auriena mekaniyukuxeɨrieni, mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: —¿Kepaɨmexɨa pepɨtatsi'iyarimɨtsitɨaka? 'Ekɨ xɨka Kɨritsitu pehɨkɨtɨni, heitseriemekɨ ketatineutaxatɨa.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'eiya: —Yanepɨtixe'utahɨawixɨri, yuri xepɨkate'erie. 'Ikɨ tita nemɨtiyuriene ne'ukiyari hetsɨa nemiemetɨtɨ, mɨkɨ nehepaɨtsita katinihekɨatani.
Matsi xeme yuri xepɨkate'erie, nemuxatsi wahetsie xemɨkamiemetekɨ.
Nemuxatsi mepɨnetsi'enie, neta nepɨwamate, mekaneniuweiyani.
Tukari mɨkaxɨwe nekaniwapitɨaka. Hatsuakuri mepɨkata'unarieni. Xewitɨ pɨkawatiwiya netsinawairienike nemamatsie.
Ne'ukiyari mɨkɨ mɨnetsiyetuiri, mɨkɨ yemekɨ kanitɨrɨkaɨyeni, hipatɨ yunaitɨ mekatɨrɨkawikaku. Xewitɨ pɨkayɨwe mɨwatiwiya 'inawairienike ne'ukiyari mamayatsie.
Ne ne'ukiyari hamatɨa tekanitaxewini.
Hikɨ huriyutsixi tawari tetexi mekaniutitɨkɨ me'ituaxake.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Kamɨ waɨkawa nepɨxe'uxeitsitɨa 'uximayatsika 'aixɨa mɨ'anene ne'ukiyari hetsɨa mɨmieme. ¿Ke'aneme 'uximayatsikakɨ xepɨnetsituaxa?
Huriyutsixi mɨpaɨ mekatenita'eiya: —'Uximayatsika 'aixɨa mɨ'anekɨ tepɨkamatsituaxa, 'axapemutainekɨ pɨta tepɨmatsituaxa. 'Ekɨ tewi pehɨkɨtɨtɨ Kakaɨyari peme'ayeitɨwakɨ.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'eiya: —Tamɨ mɨpaɨ kare'uxa xe'inɨari niukiyaritsie: “Ne mɨpaɨ nepɨtixekɨhɨawe: Xeme xepɨmamariwawe”.
Xɨkari memɨmamariwawe tiwaruterɨwa mɨkɨ wahetsɨa munua Kakaɨyari niukieya, mɨkɨ 'utɨarika xɨka kayɨweni mayeyeitɨarienikɨ,
'iya ne'ukiyari mipataxɨ yuhetsiemieme, meta kwiepa meiyenɨ'a, xeme hepaɨtsitana mieme xeputiyuane kename 'axa'utaine mɨpaɨ nemutayɨkɨ: “Kakaɨyari nu'aya nekanihɨkɨtɨni”.
Xɨka yanekatiyurieneni ne'ukiyari kemɨtiyuriene, yuri xepɨkanete'eririeka.
Peru xɨka yanetiyurieneni, tsepa yuri xemɨkanete'eririe, tita nemɨtiyurienetsie pɨta yuri xeketene'erieka mɨpaɨ xemɨtehetimanikɨ kename ne'ukiyari nehetsie tiwiya, neta ne'ukiyari hetsie netiwiya.
Hikɨ tawari mekanikuwautɨwekaitɨni me'iwiyake, mɨkɨ kaneyani meka'iwiyawekaku.
Merikɨtsɨ Ketsutsi kaneyani tawari Kurutani 'anutaɨye hakewa Wani meripaitɨ mɨre'ɨyanekai, mana kaniyuhayewa.
Yumɨiretɨ hetsɨana mekani'axekaitɨni, mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuanekaitɨni: «Wani 'inɨari pɨka'uwewi, peru naime kemɨtikuxatakai Wani 'ikɨ tewi hepaɨtsita, yuri kanainekaitɨni».
Mana yumɨiretɨ yuri mekateniuta'erieni hetsiena.
